regime_context: The Hang Seng shows a clear thematic leader in Tech Hardware & Semis, but with very narrow breadth (0.167), suggesting fragile leadership. Eligibility via the absolute-trend gate is limited to five themes; among them, High-Dividend Blue Chips stands out with the highest durability and broad participation. No rotation signal is confirmed; the macro backdrop is dominated by AI/tech and geopolitics headlines, but this is coincident, not a trigger.

theses.subject: High-Dividend Blue Chips
theses.thesis: Among eligible themes, High-Dividend Blue Chips shows the strongest trend health — the highest durability (0.72) and near-universal breadth (0.875) — aligning with the absolute-trend gate's validated risk-control edge. The theme’s low crowding and steady participation support a defensive overweight until durability weakens.
theses.dissent: High-dividend names may underperform if a sharp growth rotation occurs, and the Hong Kong market often mean-reverts within defensive sectors.
